scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspace front-end
scripts.format: prettier --write front-end/src back-end/src back-end/test back-end/scripts api docs README.md "*.json" "front-end/*.{js,json,html}" "back-end/*.{mjs,json}"
scripts.format:check: prettier --check front-end/src back-end/src back-end/test back-end/scripts api docs README.md "*.json" "front-end/*.{js,json,html}" "back-end/*.{mjs,json}"
